title: MCP tool discovery ignores tools/list pages after nextCursor

labels.name: CLI
labels.description: Issues related to the Cline CLI

body:
### Cline Surface

CLI / shared Core MCP client.

### Cline Version

Source checkout at `a459f1d04dea030833b558be645011ab739c463b`, `@cline/core` 0.2.0.

### What happened?

Both `StdioMcpClient.listTools()` and `SdkUrlMcpClient.listTools()` issue a single `tools/list` request and return that page. When the server includes `nextCursor`, its remaining tools are missing from the catalog exposed to the agent.

Expected: follow the server's opaque cursors within the same connection and return all tools. This is the [MCP pagination flow](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/utilities/pagination).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run an MCP server whose first `tools/list` response is:

```json
{
  "tools": [{ "name": "search_tickets", "inputSchema": { "type": "object" } }],
  "nextCursor": "opaque:/page+2?token=a%3Db"
}
```

2. When requested with `params.cursor` equal to that token, return:

```json
{
  "tools": [{ "name": "get_ticket", "inputSchema": { "type": "object" } }]
}
```

3. Connect through `createDefaultMcpServerClientFactory()`, using either a stdio registration or a Streamable HTTP registration, and call `client.listTools()`.

Actual: only `search_tickets` is returned; the server never receives the cursor request. Expected: `search_tickets` and `get_ticket`.

The regression fixture exercises real stdio processes and a local HTTP server using the actual MCP SDK. On unchanged source, 8 pagination assertions fail while 2 single-page controls pass. Following the cursor makes all 10 cases pass, including a three-page response with an empty middle page, metadata preservation, later-page errors and rediscovery from the first page.

### Provider/Model

MCP tool discovery, before the model request.

### System Information

Windows, Node.js 24.13.0, Bun 1.4.2.
